cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference && ls 04-functions | grep -iE 'navigation|prefetch'; ls 05-config/01-next-config-js | grep -i prefetch; ls 03-file-conventions/route-segment-config 2>/dev/null || find . -name 'prefetch*'
